result.topic_en: Calculations on transforming a second-order heat-conduction (diffusion) equation with variable coefficients into a canonical form via changes of variables and substitutions such as v = e^{m/2}; a few lines in another hand concern the thermodynamic relation dp, PV = T and c_p - c_v.
